confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate with no live listings inspected. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately reliable for a summer 2026 window. Accommodation anchors are less certain and assume July peak-season pricing including taxes and fees. The FX value was taken from RBA-domain search result text and I did not open the RBA page itself.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against mid-sized Central European tourist cities with similar price levels, such as Zagreb, Graz and Bratislava, adjusted upward for Ljubljana's summer demand and euro-zone pricing.
